title: "Sensivity antibiotics: HMP Psychoed vs. HMP Full"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(MicrobiomeStat)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
})
```

```{r}
antibiotics.1 <- antibiotics |> 
  select(id,sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics,
         sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics2y18y,
         sr_base_healthHx_antibioticsPre2yrs, sr_base_medTherapy_medAntiDep) |> 
  rename( ppt_id= id)
```

```{r}
new_sample_df <- sample_data(ps.27may) |> 
  data.frame() |> 
  dplyr::left_join(antibiotics.1, by = "ppt_id") |> 
  mutate(BW_ID_dup = BW_ID) |> 
  column_to_rownames(var="BW_ID_dup")

sample_data(ps.27may) <- new_sample_df 
```

```{r}
subject_var <- "ppt_id"
timepoint_var <- "time"

sample_df <- sample_data(ps.27may) |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  as_tibble() 


valid_subjects <- sample_df |> 
  group_by(!!sym(subject_var), !!sym(timepoint_var)) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  filter(n == 1) |> 
  group_by(!!sym(subject_var)) |> 
  summarise(n_timepoints = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  filter(n_timepoints == 2) |> 
  pull(!!sym(subject_var))


filtered_sample_ids <- sample_df %>%
  filter(!!sym(subject_var) %in% valid_subjects) %>%
  group_by(!!sym(subject_var)) |> 
  pull(BW_ID) |> 
    as.character()  
 
ps_filtered <- prune_samples(filtered_sample_ids, ps.27may)
```
Making a table that shows the numbers of people in each category

```{r}
df_1 <-sample_data(ps_filtered ) |> 
      as.data.frame() |> 
      as_tibble() 

overview_antibiotic_over <-df_1 |> 
  group_by(sr_scr_rand_group) |> 
   summarize(
    no_antibiotics_year_yes = sum(sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics == "yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    no_antibiotics_year_no = sum(sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics =="no", na.rm = TRUE),
     no_antibiotics_year_dont_know = sum(sr_base_healthHx_antibiotics == "dont_know", na.rm = TRUE),
  )

```
```{r}
overview_anidepress<-df_1 |> 
  group_by(sr_scr_rand_group) |> 
   summarize(
    Antidepressant_yes = sum(sr_base_medTherapy_medAntiDep == "1", na.rm = TRUE),
    Antidepressant_no = sum(sr_base_medTherapy_medAntiDep =="0", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
tax <- tax_table(ps_filtered)
tax_with_asv <- cbind(ASV = rownames(tax), tax)


tax_table(ps_filtered) <- tax_table(tax_with_asv)

tax_with_asv_df <- as.data.frame(tax_with_asv)
```

```{r}
 ps_uc_out <- subset_samples( ps_filtered, !sr_scr_rand_group == "uc")
```

```{r}
data.obj_uc_out <- mStat_convert_phyloseq_to_data_obj( ps_uc_out)
```

```{r}
full_act <- generate_taxa_change_test_pair(
  data.obj =   data.obj_uc_out,
  subject.var = "ppt_id",
  time.var = "time",
  group.var = "sr_scr_rand_group",
  change.base = "1",
  feature.change.func = "relative change",
  feature.level = "ASV",
  prev.filter = 0.01,
  abund.filter = 0.001,
  feature.dat.type = "count"
)

UCAct<-as.data.frame(full_act$ASV$`hmp_full vs hmp_active (Reference)`)

```

```{r}

UCAct_test <-UCAct |> 
            mutate (test_stat = Coefficient/SE)
```


```{r}
 ps_antibiotics_yes <- subset_samples(ps_filtered, sr_base_medTherapy_medAntiDep == "1")
```

```{r}
 ps_uc_out_anti <- subset_samples( ps_antibiotics_yes, !sr_scr_rand_group == "uc")
```

```{r}
data.obj_anti <- mStat_convert_phyloseq_to_data_obj( ps_uc_out_anti)
```

```{r}
full_act_anti <- generate_taxa_change_test_pair(
  data.obj =   data.obj_anti ,
  subject.var = "ppt_id",
  time.var = "time",
  group.var = "sr_scr_rand_group",
  change.base = "1",
  feature.change.func = "relative change",
  feature.level = "ASV",
  prev.filter = 0.01,
  abund.filter = 0.001,
  feature.dat.type = "count"
)

UCAct_anti<-as.data.frame(full_act_anti$ASV$`hmp_full vs hmp_active (Reference)`)
```


```{r}
UCAct_anti_test <-UCAct_anti |> 
            mutate (test_stat = Coefficient/SE)
```



```{r}
 ps_antibiotics_no <- subset_samples(ps_filtered, sr_base_medTherapy_medAntiDep == "0")
```

```{r}
 ps_uc_out_no_anti <- subset_samples( ps_antibiotics_no, !sr_scr_rand_group == "hmp_uc")
```

```{r}
data.obj_no_anti <- mStat_convert_phyloseq_to_data_obj( ps_uc_out_no_anti)
```

```{r}
full_act_no_anti <- generate_taxa_change_test_pair(
  data.obj =   data.obj_no_anti ,
  subject.var = "ppt_id",
  time.var = "time",
  group.var = "sr_scr_rand_group",
  change.base = "1",
  feature.change.func = "relative change",
  feature.level = "ASV",
  prev.filter = 0.01,
  abund.filter = 0.001,
  feature.dat.type = "count"
)

UCAct_no_anti<-as.data.frame(full_act_no_anti$ASV$`hmp_full vs hmp_active (Reference)`)
```

```{r}
UCAct_no_anti_test <-UCAct_no_anti |> 
            mutate (test_stat = Coefficient/SE)
```

```{r}
one <-UCAct_test|> 
  mutate(comparison ="FullvAct",
         Antidepresant_use = "all persons",
         ASV=Variable) |> 
  select ( ASV, comparison, SE, Antidepresant_use,Coefficient,  P.Value,Adjusted.P.Value , comparison,test_stat)
  

two<-UCAct_anti_test|> 
  mutate(comparison ="FullvAct",
         Antidepresant_use = "antidepressant use ",
         ASV=Variable) |> 
  select ( ASV, comparison, SE, Antidepresant_use,Coefficient,  P.Value,Adjusted.P.Value , comparison,test_stat)
  

three<-UCAct_no_anti_test|> 
  mutate(comparison ="FullvAct",
         Antidepresant_use = "No antidepressant use ",
         ASV=Variable) |> 
  select ( ASV, comparison, SE, Antidepresant_use, Coefficient,P.Value, Adjusted.P.Value , comparison, test_stat)

results  <-rbind (one, two, three)
```

```{r}
results.test <-results |> 
  select ( ASV, Antidepresant_use,test_stat) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Antidepresant_use, values_from = test_stat)


cor_coef <- cor.test(results.test$`all persons`,
                results.test$`antidepressant use `,
                
                method = "pearson")

cor_coef

results.test |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = (`all persons`),
    y = (`antidepressant use `)
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color= "grey30", linetype= "dashed",   size = 1    ) +
 labs(
   title = "Comparison of Test-statictic with and without antidepressant use",
   subtitle = "HMP Psychoed vs HMP-Full",
    x = "Full data set (Test-statictic)",
    y = "Participants with antidepressant use (Test-statictic)"
  )+
  theme_classic ()
```
